effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Evil], [Wizard] or [Demon Lord] trait among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into a purple Digimon, by suspending this Tamer, return 1 card from your hand to the top of your deck and gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
